environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'api-query-sanitizer' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values matching pattern '(?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|\bor\b\s+\d|\band\b\s+\d|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()' with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on 403 responses, and the ECS task role has no S3 or SSM permissions.

config.monitoring: ALB access logs to CloudWatch, metric filter on 403s
config.task_role_permissions: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents (no S3, no SSM)
